# AMA Context

1. Read `AGENTS.md` and the assigned task. Confirm the engineering role, work-package
   boundary, permitted actions, and whether this is design, implementation, review,
   or an approved deployment-related check.
   Use `delivery/workload-guidance.md` for Azure output standards and
   `delivery/multi-agent-framework.md` for development-agent collaboration.
   Read the accepted risk path and target-owner decisions from the assignment.
2. Use this source hierarchy:
   - Original brief/rubric define case requirements, not verified current law.
   - `docs/architecture/aks-centered-foundry-architecture.md` is the maintained
     technical baseline; `business-process-flow.md` defines business ownership.
   - `docs/Persona/personas-and-use-cases.md` defines business personas.
   - Crop/evidence procedures and payment research define detailed contracts.
   - Legal summaries are starting points; official current law and approved
     organisational interpretation govern applicability.
3. Read the relevant sections through `docs/delivery/context-and-tools.md`. Report
   contradictions with references; do not silently rewrite the baseline.
4. Preserve these invariants unless the user approves a recorded design change:
   - AKS Standard runs application/agent orchestration with explicit node pools and NAP disabled.
   - Foundry handles managed foundation models; Azure ML handles the custom crop
     classifier. Copernicus APIs handle appropriate raster-heavy processing.
   - Case/personal model processing uses approved EU Regional/EU Data Zone options,
     not Global deployments.
   - Classifiers use approved as-of cutoffs and may abstain. Public weak-label
     demonstration results are not inspected Hungarian ground truth.
   - Farmer evidence is normal but not universally mandatory. It cannot replace
     independent probability-sample validation; GPS is provenance, not proof.
   - Official entitlement/adverse decisions and payment execution do not belong to
     an LLM. Treasury execution is separate from case readiness.
5. The engineering team has nine roles, including application/AI and ML/data
   implementation specialists. Runtime CAP agents and business personas retain their
   architecture-defined responsibilities.
6. Check the worktree; leave unrelated files alone. Carry unresolved context and
   prerequisite gaps into the handoff rather than making up defaults.
